findings.evidence: Mutant M5 (remove the is_finite guard in ledger._money) survives. NaN and Infinity are still refused with ValueError. No test pins the Infinity message or checks which guard fired. Add an Infinity row to the parametrize table in tests/test_ledger.py (test_export_csv_refuses_an_amount_that_is_not_exact_at_two_decimals) and assert the message with match="not a finite amount" for the NaN and Infinity rows.

The CSV header is repeated as a literal in two files: HEADER in tests/test_ledger.py and HEADER_BYTES in tests/test_cli.py. OCTOBER_CSV in tests/test_cli.py also repeats the October rows that test_export_prints_the_month_as_crlf_csv_bytes builds inline. Keep one source of the header and the rows, or build the expected bytes from it. This is a manual finding. helpers_reimplemented did not measure it, because no conftest exists.

test_export_without_a_month_prints_every_expense checks only the date column (row.split(',')[0]). Category, amount and note are not asserted for the all-months export. test_export_csv_refuses_an_amount_that_is_not_exact_at_two_decimals checks only the exception type, not the message.
